verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence describes Digits exposing itself AS an MCP server (api.digits.com/mcp) so that other AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can pull Digits' financial data — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers INTO Digits so Digits' own AI (e.g. Ask Digits) can call their tools. No evidence shows Digits acting as an MCP client or supporting user-added MCP server connections.
